🗣️ Basics

Natural language processing (NLP)

In simple words

The area of AI that works with human language: understanding, translating and creating text or speech.

The area of AI that works with human language: understanding, translating, summarising and creating text or speech.

Example. Voice assistants, spell-checkers and translation apps all rely on natural language processing.

Lessons that teach it

  • Lesson 4: Generative AI & Chatbots

Related words

  • Large language model (LLM)A huge neural network trained on enormous amounts of text to predict the next token.
  • TokenA small piece of text, such as a word or part of a word, that a language model reads and writes.
  • EmbeddingA list of numbers that stands for a word, picture or other thing, so that similar things get similar numbers.
